coll.name: coll1
coll.sql: SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(' ',O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA) AS MAP_NUMEROORDEN, CONCAT(' ',O.OBSERVACIONES) AS MAP_OBSERVACIONES, IFNULL(IFNULL(ct.G3E_FID,ctc.G3E_FID),0) AS MAP_G3E_FID, IFNULL(IFNULL(ct.G3E_FNO,ctc.G3E_FNO),0) AS MAP_G3E_FNO, CASE WHEN substr(O.BRIGADA,4,1) = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MAP_EXTERNO, CONCAT('Revisión Inventario - OBLIGATORIA') as MAP_TITLE_REVINV, (select count(*) from gen_cambiosinventario cin WHERE cin.TIPO IS NULL and cin.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA=O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA AND cin.G3E_FID=IFNULL(ct.G3E_FID,ctc.G3E_FID) AND cin.G3E_FNO=IFNULL(ct.G3E_FNO,ctc.G3E_FNO)) AS MAP_CAMBIO_INV, CID.VALOR,IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC), CASE WHEN CID.VALOR IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) IS NULL THEN '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/Apoyo_Etiquetado_Blanco.png' WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/Apoyo_Etiquetado_Azul.png' ELSE '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/Apoyo_Etiquetado_Verde.png' END WHEN CID.VALOR = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/Apoyo_Etiquetado_Azul.png' ELSE '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/Apoyo_Etiquetado_Verde.png' END AS MAP_ICONO_ETIQUETADO, CASE WHEN CID.VALOR IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN CID.VALOR = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MAP_VER_NO_ACCESIBLE, IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC), CONCAT(' CT ',ct.SAP_TPLNR,' - ', CASE WHEN CID.VALOR IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) IS NULL THEN ' CT Sin etiquetar' WHEN IFNULL(ct.ID_CHIP_NFC,ctc.ID_CHIP_NFC) = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN ' CT no Accesible' ELSE ' CT Accesible' END WHEN CID.VALOR = '11:11:11:11:11' THEN ' CT No Accesible' ELSE ' CT Etiquetado' END) AS MAP_DESCRIPCION_CT, '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/qr_iberdrola.png' AS MAP_QR, concat('RESUMEN OT - ',O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA ) AS MAP_TITULO, '/var/www/vhosts/xoneideintcore.com/core/xonemonitorcore/Monitor/ide_iberdrola.png' AS MAP_LOGO, O.ID as ID, O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA, concat(' ',CASE WHEN O.UBICACION_TECNICA IS NOT NULL THEN concat(O.UBICACION_TECNICA,' - ') ELSE '' END,O.NOMBRE_UBICACION) AS MAP_INSTALACION, 'Revisión de inventario' as MAP_TITLE_ELMCTI, (SELECT count(*) FROM gen_ri_ot_elementos_rev er WHERE er.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA = O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA ) as MAP_VER_ELMCTI, 'Estudio de Inundabilidad' AS MAP_TITLE_INUNDABILIDAD, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM gen_inundabilidad_rec_bloques_rev ir WHERE ir.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA = O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA AND ir.revisado = 1) AS MAP_VER_INUNDABILIDAD, O.UBICACION_TECNICA AS MAP_UBICACION_TECNICA from gen_rec_ot_cabecera O left outer join gen_ct ct on ct.g3e_fid = O.FID_UT left outer join gen_ctc ctc on ctc.g3e_fid = O.FID_UT left join gen_maestroveclactmvl gm on gm.COD_CLA_CTM = IFNULL(ct.COD_CLA_CT,ctc.COD_CLA_CTC) LEFT OUTER JOIN (select MAX(ID) AS ID,G3E_FID,G3E_FNO,ATTR from gen_cambiosinventario WHERE TIPO='CT_ETQ' AND ATTR='ID_CHIP_NFC' group by G3E_FID,G3E_FNO,ATTR) CI ON CI.G3E_FID=IFNULL(ct.G3E_FID,ctc.G3E_FID) AND CI.G3E_FNO=IFNULL(ct.G3E_FNO,ctc.G3E_FNO) LEFT OUTER JOIN gen_cambiosinventario CID ON CID.ID=CI.ID AND CID.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA=O.COD_REC_OT_CABECERA
coll.filter: O.ID=##ID## and (ct.ID is not null or ctc.ID is not NULL) order by O.ID DESC

coll.name: Inventario
coll.sql: SELECT CONCAT(' ',ATTR) AS ATTR, CONCAT(' ',VALOR) AS VALOR, CONCAT(' ',VALOR_ANT) AS VALOR_ANT, CONCAT('Revisión Inventario') as MAP_TITLE_REVINV from gen_cambiosinventario cin

coll.name: Inundabilidad
coll.sql: SELECT CONCAT(' ', CASE WHEN ct.B_INUNDABILIDAD = 1 THEN 'SI' WHEN ct.B_INUNDABILIDAD = 0 THEN 'NO' ELSE '' END) AS MAP_B_INUNDABILIDAD, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_INUND, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_INUND, CONCAT(' ', CASE WHEN ct.B_INUNDADO = 1 THEN 'SI' WHEN ct.B_INUNDADO = 0 THEN 'NO' ELSE '' END) AS MAP_B_INUNDADO, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_RASANTE_SUELO, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_RASANTE_SUELO, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_RASANTE_AGUA, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_RASANTE_AGUA, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(mrv.DES_DESCRIPCION, '')) AS MAP_RIESGO_INUND, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_RASANTE_EQ_STAR, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_RASANTE_EQ_STAR, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_RASANTE_MAN_CEL, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_RASANTE_MAN_CEL, CONCAT(' ', IFNULL(ct.CAN_ALT_RASANTE_CBT, '')) AS MAP_CAN_ALT_RASANTE_CBT FROM gen_ct ct LEFT JOIN gen_inundabilidad_rec_bloques_rev rev ON rev.G3E_FID = ct.G3E_FID AND rev.G3E_FNO = ct.G3E_FNO LEFT JOIN gen_maestrovetipriesgoinundvl mrv ON mrv.COD_TIP_RIESGO_INUND = ct.COD_TIP_RIESGO_INUND
